main_visual_task: The same electric sedan flows silently along a sunrise coastal road while the camera tracks alongside it in one continuous parallel move, ending as the car heads toward a distant city skyline.

matched_cut.in_state: starts from the lit front of the same car leaving the garage into morning light
matched_cut.out_state: car small in frame heading toward the far city skyline on the horizon, ready for S3 overlook at dusk

prompt_bible.subject_lock: the same one silver-grey electric concept sedan with a smooth closed front fascia, one thin full-width LED light bar, flush door handles, aerodynamic covered wheels, dark panoramic glass roof, badge-free body
prompt_bible.environment_lock: empty two-lane coastal road at sunrise, calm sea on the left, low sun ahead-left, smooth asphalt with gentle right curve, no other cars, no people
prompt_bible.material_lock: brushed silver-grey paint catching sunrise speculars, dark glass roof, smooth asphalt, sea and low clouds
prompt_bible.lighting_lock: low warm sunrise key from ahead-left with cool sky fill; sun stays at the same height throughout the segment
prompt_bible.palette_lock: silver grey, warm amber sunrise, cool blue sea, graphite asphalt
prompt_bible.lens_texture: photoreal cinema lens, telephoto side-profile compression, natural motion blur on ground, crisp car body
prompt_bible.screen_direction: the car travels screen-left to screen-right the whole time; the sea stays left, land stays right; never reverse
prompt_bible.audio_policy: quiet electric motor hum, soft tire-on-asphalt, distant waves and morning air, no music, no voice

timeline.visual_state: the sedan glides along the coastal road in clean side profile, sea and low sun on the left
timeline.subject_action: the car rolls steadily screen-left to screen-right with covered wheels turning smoothly
timeline.camera_action: track alongside the car in one continuous parallel move at matched speed, profile view
timeline.lighting_state: low warm sunrise key with cool fill

timeline.visual_state: closer profile, sunrise speculars slide along the silver flank
timeline.subject_action: the car holds a steady line; reflections of the low sun travel across paint and glass roof
timeline.camera_action: continue the same parallel tracking move slightly closer
timeline.focus: body flank and glass roof reflections
timeline.end_state: car fills more of frame, still profile

timeline.visual_state: front three-quarter view as the road curves gently right
timeline.subject_action: the car follows the curve without leaning; light bar and closed fascia stay clean
timeline.camera_action: maintain the same continuous tracking alongside, now seeing the front three-quarter angle
timeline.focus: front fascia and light bar with sea behind

timeline.visual_state: the road straightens toward a distant city skyline on the horizon
timeline.subject_action: the car draws slightly ahead of the camera and begins to shrink toward the skyline
timeline.camera_action: hold the same parallel tracking move as the car eases ahead

timeline.visual_state: the silver sedan recedes along the empty road toward the far city skyline
timeline.subject_action: steady silent motion toward the skyline
timeline.camera_action: camera decelerates the tracking move to a stop
timeline.end_state: stable wide frame with car small ahead of camera, clean matched-cut endpoint

camera_plan.motivation: let the viewer ride alongside the silent flow of the car and then release it toward the city of the finale
camera_plan.start_position: wide clean side profile of the moving car, tracking at matched speed
camera_plan.path: one continuous parallel tracking move alongside the car at matched speed, easing from profile to front three-quarter as the road curves, never crossing ahead of the car
camera_plan.speed_curve: matched constant speed, gentle deceleration in the final second
camera_plan.focus_transition: full profile to flank reflections to front three-quarter to car against skyline
camera_plan.end_position: wide shot with the car small ahead toward the city skyline
camera_plan.axis_lock: car always travels screen-left to screen-right, sea left, land right; camera never crosses to the other side of the car
camera_plan.stop_condition: stop after the car settles small in frame toward the skyline

first_frame: the silver-grey electric sedan in clean side profile gliding on a sunrise coastal road with the sea on the left
last_frame: the sedan small on the empty road heading toward the distant city skyline, sunrise behind
